snippet.title: 【KASSO GAIDEN: Escape from the Skaterverse】 Concept Trailer
snippet.description:
KASSO is coming to gaming🎮

🛹KASSO GAIDEN: Escape from the Skaterverse🛹

Ollie and grind a path back to reality in KASSO GAIDEN: Escape from the Skaterverse, the mobile game now available on both iOS and Android devices!

🔥🔥Download now 🔥🔥
https://onelink.to/pn486h

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーー
Endless skateboarding!? 
Sounds like paradise…but a few wrong moves means being trapped in a retro neon lo-fi universe for eternity. Brave the Skaterverse — a world beyond the rift in time and space, where the most gnarly sections imagined by skaters manifest as a course that strikes back.

Grab one of 43 different boards and ollie over lava pits, dodge incoming traffic, avoid falling spikes, and duck underneath floating platforms in high-speed gameplay requiring quick decisions and even faster reflexes. Build up speed to get maximum air on ramps, and unleash 35 distinct tricks for style points while blazing a path back to reality.

In rhythm game fashion, hit the sound notes along the way, laid out to be collected on-beat according to each level’s soundtrack. Dominate all seven street courses, unlocking exclusive board designs and three bonus characters along the way.

#KASSOGAIDEN
#mobilegame
#skateboard
